manifest.name: dsh-update-checker
manifest.description: DSH profile plugin: notify in the web sidebar when a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh version is available on npm

bundle.text:
# dsh-update-checker bundle layer: mount the plugin rows when a profile
# lists this bundle. Applied after @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and other bundles,
# before the profile's own cordis.patch.yml.
- insert:
    - id: update-checker
      name: dsh-update-checker

readme.text:
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) profile plugin: checks the npm registry for newer
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` releases at startup and shows a quiet, GUI-styled notice in
the web sidebar when an update is available — click it to copy the update
command or open the npm page.

- Checks `registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh` at startup (fire-and-forget,
  never blocks boot), cached for 6 hours; re-polls every 30 min in the GUI
- Only appears when a newer version actually exists — silent otherwise
- Sidebar footer item (expanded: icon + "vX.Y.Z 可用"; collapsed: icon only)
- Popover with: current/latest version, one-click **copy** of the update
  command, npm link, and **忽略此版本** (dismiss per version)
- Style tokens from the DSH GUI (`--dsw-*` design system) — auto-adapts to
  light/dark themes
- Zero disk footprint: host side is pure in-memory; the only persistent state
  is a single localStorage key (dismissed version, a few bytes, overwritten —
  never grows)
- Fail-safe: registry unreachable or network errors → nothing is shown,
  nothing crashes

This is an official DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle` manifest + in-package
`cordis.patch.yml`), so it installs through the standard plugin command:

```bash

readme.section: from the directory that contains the plugin checkout:
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-update-checker
```

`dsh plugin` (requires [pnpm](https://pnpm.io)) links the package into the
profile, appends the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the bundle's own
patch layer mounts the plugin. Verify without booting, then boot/restart:bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-update-checker" layer
dsh --profile web
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-update-checker`.

readme.section: from the directory that contains the plugin checkout:
readme.text:
> For a running harness the bundle takes effect on the next restart —
> profile `package.json` is not hot-reloaded (only `cordis.patch.yml` is).
> Older DSH versions without `dsh plugin`: copy the package into
> `$DSH_HOME/profiles/packages/`, link it into
> `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/`, and insert `update-checker` in the
> profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

| Side | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET /dsh-update-checker/check`; queries the npm registry on startup and on stale reads (6 h TTL); semver comparison (prerelease-aware); local version read from the running `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Sidebar footer slot item; polls the endpoint every 30 min; popover with copy/npm/dismiss actions; dismissal persisted per version in localStorage |

The popover copies:

```bash
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest --profile web
```

Stop the running harness first, run it in a terminal, then reopen the GUI.

- Remove the `update-checker` entry from `cordis.patch.yml`
- Remove `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-update-checker` and
  `~/.dsh/profiles/packages/dsh-update-checker`
- Optional: delete the `dsh-update-checker.dismissed` key from browser
  localStorage
